note: Where this repository's deploy job (.github/workflows/next-deploy.yml, scripts/hosting/deploy.mjs) and promote.py may publish (fm-6fx6). Exactly one repository publishes a target at a time. scripts/hosting/publish-guard.mjs refuses, before any network call, a target the repository variable FACEMORPH_PUBLISH_TARGETS does not name, a target marked classicOwned, and any target sharing a Worker, bucket or host with a classicOwned one. classicOwned stays true for next and production until delivery's candidate-source handover (scripts/delivery/runbook.json) moves the publisher here; the handover change sets it false and the operator names the target in the variable. Classic keeps publishing until then.

staging.purpose: Test target for the deploy dry run: a workers.dev site and its test mirror. Holds only published runtime and artifact bytes; never user data.

next.purpose: next.facemorph.me and its runtime mirror; classic next-site.yml publishes both until the candidate-source handover.

production.purpose: facemorph.me; production promotion is a separate operator decision (fm-fy2.12).
